note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described; the description is taken from an unpublished manuscript by Bose; synonymy, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to dark brown; antennae brown, darkening towards apex; mandibles dark brown, pale brown at base; pronotum and legs pale yellow to light yellowish brown; abdomen creamy yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Body length 4.60–5.0 mm. Head oval, longer than wide, length to base of mandibles 1.28–1.40 mm, maximum width 1.13–1.15 mm; distinctly narrowed anteriorly to the base of the mandibles, width at base of mandibles 0.68–0.75 mm, cephalic convergence index 0.602–0.644. Antennae 16-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus trapezoidal, boundary with frons indistinct; anterior part with one long hair on each side. Anteclypeus thin, linear. Labrum triangular-lingulate, 0.33–0.35 mm long, 0.28–0.30 mm wide; with 4 pairs of long setae. Mandibles sickle-shaped, moderately stout, 0.78–0.83 mm long, about 0.59–0.60 of head length. Left mandible with one prominent tooth slightly before the apical third, tooth distance/mandible length 0.253–0.287. Right mandible with one minute tooth slightly below the apical third, tooth distance/mandible length 0.337–0.361. Postmentum broadly barrel-shaped, maximum width about four-fifths of its length, 0.75–0.87 mm long, 0.58–0.63 mm maximum width, 0.35–0.38 mm wide at anterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin moderately to distinctly notched at middle, posterior margin weakly incurved, 0.50–0.53 mm long, 0.80–0.87 mm wide. Mesonotum narrower, metanotum almost as wide as pronotum.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; postclypeus paler; antennae light brown, darkening towards apex; pronotum and legs creamy yellow; abdomen nearly white. Body length 4.30–4.80 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long, length to apex of labrum 1.70–1.75 mm, length to base of mandibles 1.23–1.25 mm, maximum width 1.40–1.45 mm. Antennae 19-segmented; segment 3 shortest; segments 4 and 5 subequal in length. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, divided into two halves, less than half as long as wide, 0.25 mm long, 0.70 mm wide. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, glabrous. Labrum broadly lingulate, 0.45–0.50 mm long, 0.50 mm wide; anterior margin and body hairy. Pronotum as in the soldier, 0.40–0.45 mm long, 0.75 mm wide; anterior and posterior margins both distinctly notched.
